checks: CSV and JSON contain the same number of records.
All IDs and case-sensitive question-plus-sorted-option fingerprints are unique.
Each record has four or five nonempty labelled options.
Source PDF page references are between 1 and 103.
limitations: Option labels alone do not prove correct question/option association.
Superscripts, roots, fractions, scientific notation and units may be damaged in text extraction.
Some questions include text fragments from neighbouring columns.
Diagrams are not extracted or hosted; image_url is null.
Years are intentionally null because heading placement and reading order are unreliable.
Near duplicates require manual review; quantities and unit case must be preserved.
